roles.title: Paver Operator
roles.text: Run our asphalt paver on driveway, parking lot and private road jobs. You set the pace for the crew and the finish the customer sees.
requirements: Paver experience preferred. Tell us what you have run.
Can hold a steady mat thickness and a straight edge
Takes care of equipment like it is your own
Shows up on time, every day

roles.title: Laborer
roles.text: Work behind the paver and on the ground: raking and luting hot mix, running a plate compactor, shoveling, setting up and cleaning up job sites. It is hot, physical work and it shows at the end of the day.
requirements: Shows up on time, every day
Can work outdoors in East Texas heat

roles.title: Dump Truck Driver
roles.text: Haul hot mix, base rock and fill to our jobs and help on the ground between loads.
requirements: Valid license for the truck you drive
Comfortable backing into tight residential sites

roles.title: Sales
roles.text: Talk with customers, go out to their home or business, measure the job, draw it up and mark it out on the ground. You are the first person from CGH they meet, and the one who makes sure the crew knows exactly what was promised.
requirements: Comfortable talking with customers face to face
Basic math and geometry: figuring square feet from measurements and odd shapes
Can sketch a job and mark it out on site
Honest about what a job needs, even when it costs the sale
